title: #357 Human and Earth
prompt: Some people believe that the Earth is being harmed by human activity. Others feel that human activity makes the Earth a better place to live. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people believe that the Earth is being harmed by human activity.
Others feel that human activity makes the Earth a better place to live.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Human actions can make the Earth worse for living.

angles.en: Human actions can make the Earth a better place to live.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Human actions can make the Earth a better place to live.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Human actions can help the environment by planting trees and cleaning the air.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Human actions can improve human life by building useful things and growing more food.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Human actions can improve human life by building useful things and growing more food.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Human activities improve the environment by developing efficient ways to use natural resources, such as creating solar power plants, which improves air quality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Human activities improve the environment by developing efficient ways to use natural resources, such as creating solar power plants, which improves air quality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Human innovation helps manage waste and improve living conditions, exemplified by advanced recycling facilities that reduce landfill waste.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Human innovation helps manage waste and improve living conditions, exemplified by advanced recycling facilities that reduce landfill waste.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Human activities provide many benefits to the environment, such as improving water systems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Human activities provide many benefits to the environment, such as improving water systems.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Human actions help in developing new resources, like clean energy from solar power.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Human actions help in developing new resources, like clean energy from solar power.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: present a balanced argument on whether human activity harms or benefits the Earth, using evidence from both sides.
keyArguments: Human activity has caused significant environmental damage, such as pollution and deforestation.
However, human activity has also led to advancements in sustainability and conservation efforts.
